description:
Run a $1 static Security Preflight and return a signed receipt.

    Direct MCP requires the checkout caller and verified fixed-order session.
    The separate x402 HTTP rail retains its existing introductory quote policy.
    No deployed endpoint is fetched or tested. Importing the receipt into an
    Agent Market profile is a separate, explicit action.

agent_id.description: Id of the agent or server being checked.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

manifest.description: The server's manifest: tools, schemas, declared permissions.
manifest.title: Manifest

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

policy.description: Optional. The policy to check against.
policy.title: Policy

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

session_id.description: The verified checkout session id. Required for direct MCP calls.
session_id.title: Session Id

subject_profile_sha256.description: Optional. SHA-256 of a subject profile, to bind into the receipt.
subject_profile_sha256.title: Subject Profile Sha256

name: security_preflight
title: Static agent manifest assessment
